subject: paediatrics
title: Leukaemias and lymphomas: ALL, AML and Hodgkin staging

steps.tx: **ALL** (**commonest** 2 to 5 years, **pallor fever bone pain**, **lymphoblasts** TdT CD10, **hyperdiploidy TEL-AML** good, **BCR-ABL Ph** TKI, **infant KMT2A** poor; **prednisone day 8** response, **MRD** flow guides, **CNS** intrathecal methotrexate) with **Down** (DS-ALL higher relapse, **methotrexate** toxicity, reduced intensity) treats; **tumour lysis** (rasburicase hydrate) prevents. Marrows blast.
steps.say: Pale febrile achy blasts TdT hyperdiploid good Ph TKI is ALL: day 8 steroids MRD intrathecals. Down reduced.

steps.tx: **AML** (**Auer rods**, **DIC** promyelocytic ATRA arsenic, **Down TAM** resolves, **monosomy 7** poor, **anthracycline** daunorubicin hearts, **transplant** high risk MRD) with **CML** (**BCR-ABL** imatinib, **leukostasis** apheresis) and **JMML** (Noonan NF1 monocytosis, **transplant** only) myeloid; **chloroma** (orbital, ATRA) spots. Rods differentiate.
steps.say: Rods DIC ATRA arsenic TAM resolves is AML: anthracycline hearts transplants high. Imatinib chronic.

vis.alt: Microscopic image of a myeloblast containing distinct, rod-shaped Auer rods, a key diagnostic marker for Acute Myeloid Leukemia.

steps.tx: **Hodgkin** (**Reed-Sternberg CD15 CD30**, **nodular sclerosis** mediastinal teens, **B symptoms** fever night sweats weight, **ABVD** doxorubicin bleomycin lungs, **radiation** selected, **relapse** transplant brentuximab) with **NHL** (**Burkitt** jaw starry jaw tumour lysis, **lymphoblastic** T mediastinal, **anaplastic large** ALK, **R-CHOP**-like BFM) nodes; **staging** (Ann Arbor PET) scans. Sternbergs stare.
steps.say: Bimodal itchy mediastinal Sternberg CD30 is Hodgkin: ABVD lungs radiation selected transplants relapse. Burkitts jaw lyse.

steps.tx: **Support** (**febrile neutropenia** cultures cefepime, **transfuse** thresholds irradiated, **nausea** ondansetron, **mucositis** mouth care, **fertility** cryopreserve, **late** anthracycline hearts second cancers) with **palliative** (refractory comfort, **hospice** home) and **survivor** (growth thyroid neurocognitive, **vaccines** revaccinate, **school** plans) follows; **trials** (CAR-T relapsed B-ALL) enrol. Counts nadir.
